forecast_metrics.target: Weekly observed positive unit sales; not unconstrained demand.
forecast_metrics.design: Fixed-origin four-week forecasts. Top products selected before validation. No future sales features.

recommendation_metrics.scope: Returning customers with unseen purchases in the training top-1500 catalogue. Previously purchased products excluded; not all-customer performance.

audit.duplicate_policy: Retained: identical line items are not necessarily duplicated events.
audit.sales_definition: Positive merchandise purchases only: numeric five-digit SKU with optional letter suffix; credit invoices and fee codes excluded. GBP, not profit.
